create_optimizer: create an optimizer with per-network learning rates for lipreading, facial, unet, and vocal networks
display_val: display validation losses for mix-and-separate, co-separation, and crossmodal tasks on a validation dataset
get_mixandseparate_loss: compute mix-and-separate loss from predicted and ground-truth spectrogram masks with per-source weighting
get_coseparation_loss: compute co-separation triplet loss from audio embeddings of separated sources
get_crossmodal_loss: compute crossmodal triplet loss linking audio embeddings with facial and vocal identity features
